---
title: "About"
---

## What this is

This site is an automatically generated exploratory-data-analysis portfolio
built on top of [TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday),
the weekly R community data project. Every week, TidyTuesday publishes one or
more datasets along with a data dictionary describing each variable.

## How it's built

1. A [GitHub Actions workflow](https://github.com/features/actions) polls the
   upstream TidyTuesday repository on a schedule, looking for a weekly data
   folder that hasn't been turned into a page yet.
2. When it finds one, it scaffolds a new page (`posts/<date>/index.qmd`) with
   one section per dataset in that week's release.
3. [Quarto](https://quarto.org) renders each page: for every variable in every
   dataset, it downloads the data straight from TidyTuesday, reads the
   variable's official description from the dataset's data dictionary, and
   draws a distribution plot — a histogram for numeric/date variables, a bar
   chart for categorical/logical variables — titled with the variable name and
   subtitled with its description.
4. The rendered site is published to GitHub Pages. Any change pushed to the
   repository — a new page or a manual edit — triggers a rebuild and
   redeploy automatically.

The full source, including the R code that does the fetching, parsing, and
plotting, lives in this repository under `R/`.
